title: Vendor openness and substitution findings

evidence_window.scope: Retained 17-vendor documentary ledger, normalized projection, primary-source addendum and original aggregate findings page.

aggregate_conclusion: Of 17 vendors, 15 make public openness or interoperability claims. Three have published mission-autonomy substitution evidence; nine have integration accounts; five have no retrieved substitution result. The reviewed record contains no demonstrated substitution below mission autonomy.

local_execution.qualification: Public reports and local execution are separate evidence dimensions. No local vendor execution is established by these retained records.

qualifications: The fifteen claims vary in scope: interfaces, payload protocols, platform independence, manufacturing, retained customer IP and wider interoperability. The count does not establish whole-stack openness.

Three counts vendor records with reported component substitution, not locally executed stacks or a count derived by adding all reports. Their lead reports concern three distinct flight events; some vendors participate in more than one event.
The lower-layer finding is bounded to the reviewed evidence. The original review allowed at most eight searches and eight page reads per vendor; an unretrieved result is not proof of global absence.
The original opposite-claim category records Castelion and Saronic vertical-integration statements. Vertical integration alone does not establish closed interfaces.
Retained quote matching establishes presence of cited wording. Claim truth, applicability and execution remain separate questions.
The original claimed-open page predates current primary-source corrections; its former readable-terms total and unqualified contract statements are not incorporated into these counts.

derivation.openness: Count original ledger records where claim.kind equals open-claim.
derivation.local_execution: All normalized local_execution.status values equal not_established; aggregate projection records zero locally executed implementations.
derivation.lower_layer_finding: Compare all three substitution-row summaries and their primary addenda with the bounded original claimed-open page finding.

projection.scope: Authored summaries and public citations from the dated vendor review. Local collection checks these included bytes and their projections; it does not fetch or reverify the cited websites.

source_date_basis: The retained primary_addendum_date and reviewed_at use UTC; that addendum occurred on 27 November 2026 Pacific.
